CREATE TABLE scale_alembic_version (
	version_num VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT scale_alembic_version_pkc PRIMARY KEY (version_num)
)

CREATE TABLE scale_order (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	total NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	payload VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id, created_at), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scale_order_status CHECK (status IN ('created','paid','cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scale_order_values CHECK (id>0 AND user_id>0 AND total>=0)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB
CREATE INDEX ix_user ON scale_order (user_id)

CREATE TABLE scale_order_partitioned (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL,

	user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	total NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL,

	payload VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,

	CONSTRAINT ck_scale_order_partitioned_status CHECK (status IN ('created','paid','cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scale_order_partitioned_values CHECK (id>0 AND user_id>0 AND total>=0)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB
CREATE INDEX ix_user ON scale_order_partitioned (user_id)

CREATE TABLE scale_dataset (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	seed BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	order_count BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	batch_size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generator_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,

  `id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `total` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `payload` varchar(160) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `ix_time` (`created_at`,`id`),
  KEY `ix_user_cover` (`user_id`,`created_at`,`id`,`total`,`status`),

  CONSTRAINT `ck_scale_order_partitioned_values` CHECK (((`id` > 0) and (`user_id` > 0) and (`total` >= 0)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
/*!50500 PARTITION BY RANGE  COLUMNS(created_at)
(PARTITION p1 VALUES LESS THAN ('2025-04-01') ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION p2 VALUES LESS THAN ('2025-07-01') ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION p3 VALUES LESS THAN ('2025-10-01') ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION p4 VALUES LESS THAN ('2026-01-01') ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION p_future VALUES LESS THAN (MAXVALUE) ENGINE = InnoDB) */

statistics.semantics: InnoDB allocated-page estimates, not physical file bytes. TABLE_ROWS/cardinality estimates differ from exact streamed count. Partition index table names retained verbatim.

writes.semantics: Initially empty tables, same prepared rows, rotating layout order. Batch execute+COMMIT only, generation/hash/readback excluded. Not million-existing-row write amplification; shared cache/order remain confounders.

definitions.client_ms: SELECT execute/fetch wall, one client, warmup1; not server-only or concurrent HTTP RPS
definitions.access_operator_rows: sum(actual access iterator output rows*loops), not physical I/O; nested iterator times not summed
definitions.coverage: Actual EXPLAIN JSON using_index, not using_index_condition
definitions.partitions: Optimizer-selected partitions from EXPLAIN JSON; null means unpartitioned/not reported, not empty
definitions.space: InnoDB allocation/page/cardinality estimates, not file bytes
definitions.write: Initially empty tables, same prepared rows, rotating layout order. Batch execute+COMMIT only, generation/hash/readback excluded. Not million-existing-row write amplification; shared cache/order remain confounders.

limitations: Small warm repeated samples; P95/P99 interpolation not production tail estimates
Fixed sequential baseline/composite/covering phases have cache/order confounding
Analytical snapshot: matching compositePK(id,created_at), no business foreign keys or DB id-only unique constraint
Partitioning affects only matching predicates; no universal speedup or automatic sharding conclusion
Failed runs retained incomplete and excluded from complete catalogue; zero query failures applies only to these completed samples
